data.title: The Arthouse
data.about:
Art House, situated on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, seamlessly combines modern design with cultural richness. This exclusive residential project, currently under construction, offers premium 1, 2, 2-plus, and 3 bedroom apartments, including 2 luxurious sky villas.

Inspired by private members’ clubs worldwide, Art House provides like-minded residents with purposefully designed spaces that stimulate creativity and connection. The development features rich architectural details and multifaceted interiors crafted by the award-winning DiLeonardo, making it a "gallery for living" for those with a discerning taste for arts and culture. Unique spaces like an art studio, gallery, and creative rooftop majlis form the vibrant community's core, fostering collaboration and co-creation in Abu Dhabi’s most coveted neighborhood.

Developed by Aldar Properties, ART HOUSE Abu Dhabi is the first residential development in Saadiyat Cultural District to boast a stunning rooftop setting with pools and a garden. Residents can enjoy breathtaking views of architectural masterpieces and the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf. Aldar's dedication to sustainable living is evidenced by ART HOUSE’s 3 Pearl Estidama rating and its aim for a 2-star Fitwel certification.

characteristics_module.title: EXCLUSIVE PRIVATE MEMBERS’ CLUB-INSPIRED HOMES
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi, in the heart of the cultural district with direct access to Saadiyat Grove’s upscale retail and leisure.
  • Cultural Proximity: Surrounded by renowned cultural institutions such as Louvre Abu Dhabi, Zayed National Museum, The Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi, and TeamLab Phenomena.
  • Luxurious Residences: Offers premium 1, 2, 2 plus, and 3 bedroom apartments, including two sky villas starting at 3.3M AED.
  • Modern Amenities: Features amenities like a Creative Majlis, Arthouse Cinema, Health Club, Art Studio, Supper Club, and more.
  • Stylish Interiors: Includes premium branded kitchens and wardrobes.
  • Breathtaking Views: Provides spectacular views of Saadiyat Island’s architecture and the Arabian Gulf.
  • Sustainable Living: Achieves a 3 Pearl Estidama rating, targeting a 2-star Fitwel certification.
  • Trusted Developer: Developed by Aldar Properties, renowned for quality and innovation.

location_tile.title: Strategically located on Saadiyat Island
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Art House provides direct access to Saadiyat Grove's upscale retail and leisure experiences, beachfront dining at Mamsha Al Saadiyat, and the pristine Soul Beach. Art House offers more than just a place to live; it delivers a luxurious lifestyle. Residents can enjoy high-end retail and dining options, as well as leisure activities right at their doorstep. The development is also conveniently close to world-class educational institutions like Cranleigh Abu Dhabi, Berklee Abu Dhabi, and New York University Abu Dhabi, making it an ideal choice for families seeking top-tier education.

7 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
10 minutes to Sheikh Zayed University
10 minutes to IMG Worlds of Adventure
12 minutes to Global Village
20 minutes to Burj Khalifa
